description:
# 1.1.0

Feature and alignment release for YouTube 19.16.39.

Features:

- YouTube - Add missing resources: Add aliases for modern server-side Shorts action button resources while preserving the original YouTube 19.16.39 white shadowed icons.
- YouTube - SponsorBlock: Align with Anddea 4.1.0-dev.1 highlight submission and saved time fixes.
- YouTube - Change share sheet: Align with Anddea 4.1.0-dev.1 system share sheet fix.
- YouTube - Gemini: Align model list with Anddea 4.1.0-dev.1.

Bug Fixes:

- YouTube - Add missing resources: Avoid transparent fallback for original Shorts action buttons when spoofed layouts request newer resource names.
- YouTube - Theme/Splash: Align dark mode splash screen fix with Anddea 4.1.0-dev.1.

Credits:

- anddea/revanced-patches
- MorpheApp/morphe-patches and MorpheApp/morphe-manager
- kitadai31/revanced-patches-android6-7
